questions.question:
Identify the sentence that correctly uses inversion to emphasize the adverbial clause.

A. Only after the rain had stopped did they begin to clean the garden.
B. Only after the rain had stopped they began to clean the garden.
C. Only after the rain had stopped did they begin to clean the garden.
D. Only after the rain had stopped they began to clean the garden.
options: Only after the rain had stopped did they begin to clean the garden.
Only after the rain had stopped they began to clean the garden.
Only after the rain had stopped did they begin to clean the garden.
Only after the rain had stopped they began to clean the garden.
questions.answer: Only after the rain had stopped did they begin to clean the garden.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly forms a cleft sentence to highlight the specific detail about the discovery?

A. It was in the old library that the historian found the rare manuscript.
B. It was the old library that the historian found the rare manuscript.
C. It was in the old library where the historian found the rare manuscript.
D. It was the old library which the historian found the rare manuscript.
options: It was in the old library that the historian found the rare manuscript.
It was the old library that the historian found the rare manuscript.
It was in the old library where the historian found the rare manuscript.
It was the old library which the historian found the rare manuscript.
questions.answer: It was in the old library that the historian found the rare manuscript.
